title: Policy Gradients for Cumulative Prospect Theory in Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2410.02605v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We derive a policy gradient theorem for Cumulative Prospect Theory (CPT) objectives in finite-horizon Reinforcement Learning (RL), generalizing the standard policy gradient theorem and encompassing distortion-based risk objectives as special cases. Motivated by behavioral economics, CPT combines an asymmetric utility transformation around a reference point with probability distortion. Building on our theorem, we design a first-order policy gradient algorithm for CPT-RL using a Monte Carlo gradient estimator based on order statistics. We establish statistical guarantees for the estimator and prove asymptotic convergence of the resulting algorithm to first-order stationary points of the (generally nonconvex) CPT objective. We complement our asymptotic analysis with a non-asymptotic total sample complexity analysis to reach an approximate first-order stationary policy. translated_title: 强化学习中累积前景理论的策略梯度
translated_abstract: 我们在有限时域强化学习（RL）中为累积前景理论（CPT）目标推导了策略梯度定理，该定理推广了标准策略梯度定理，并将基于失真的风险目标作为特例纳入其中。受行为经济学的启发，CPT将围绕参考点的不对称效用变换与概率失真相结合。基于我们的定理，我们设计了一种用于CPT-RL的一阶策略梯度算法，该算法使用基于次序统计量的蒙特卡洛梯度估计器。我们为该估计器建立了统计保证，并证明了所得算法渐近收敛于（通常是非凸的）CPT目标的一阶稳定点。我们通过非渐近的总样本复杂度分析来补充渐近分析，以达到近似的一阶稳定策略。仿真结果展示了CPT所引起的定性行为特征。
tldr: 本文为强化学习中的累积前景理论（CPT）目标推导了策略梯度定理，并基于次序统计量的蒙特卡洛估计器设计了具有渐近收敛性和样本复杂度保证的一阶策略梯度算法。
en_tdlr: This paper derives a policy gradient theorem for Cumulative Prospect Theory (CPT) objectives in reinforcement learning and designs a first-order policy gradient algorithm with asymptotic convergence and sample complexity guarantees using a Monte Carlo estimator based on order statistics.
